requirement: TSK-02「使用者可以訓練、推論與評估語音轉文字。驗收：整檔與串流文字輸出完整，分塊恢復與 CER/WER 可重現，不以聲音分類替代。」
scope: Acceptance review of ticket 29 stage two at fixture level. Each acceptance item is mapped to the tests and runs already recorded in evidence/TSK-02/verification.json and stream-file-verification.json, and those checks are rerun at the current commit. Real authorised speech is TSK-11 (blocked_data), the same split under which TSK-01 was accepted.
reproduction_command: compare the two reports with the timing object and every *_ns field removed (reproducibility.txt)
environment: go version go1.26.5 darwin/arm64 (macOS, Apple M3, 8 cores, 16 GiB), commit 79ca9790da45e33e2d3aed6883c0e96f0a798db9, run from a detached worktree pinned at that commit.
2026-09-23T18:35:56Z to 18:37:03Z at 1-minute load 12.85 to 11.61 (other test runs were active); no timing in this review is a result.
input_fingerprints: No external input: the CLI generates 4 groups of 10 synthetic tone utterances (alphabet a/b/c, 1..3 runes, 120 ms tones with 40 ms gaps, 16 kHz) in memory, splits them by speaker/session into 30 train and 10 test, and trains 10 epochs (config in the report).

asr-run1.json sha256 3431e902fc52664a3d2321c8e3d425916bdf698aaa1225ba9bf2b9e91178b4fe; asr-run2.json sha256 bc232cf1000d32cf196a1094a35971d79fc3a402e02a272850aacbb976405cd3 (they differ only in timing fields).

observed_result.tests: asr-race.log: 79 top-level PASS in tasks/asr and tasks/asr/audio under -race, 0 FAIL; cli-race.log: the 4 examples run asr tests PASS; vet.log: no findings.

acceptance_items.whole_file_and_streaming_output: TestStreamMatchesWholeFile: the chunked stream decodes the same text as the whole file; TestEvaluateStreaming scores every utterance. In the CLI run the whole-file and the 173-sample streaming evaluation give the same CER 12/19 and WER 9/10 on the 10 held-out utterances, with 10 per-utterance streaming measurements.
acceptance_items.chunk_recovery: TestStreamResumesFromSnapshot (a stream restored from a snapshot continues exactly as the uninterrupted one), TestStreamTailAndFlush and TestStreamFlushesAnInitialShortTail (a tail shorter than one window and the final flush), TestStreamFileAcrossProcess (a saved stream file resumed in a new process ends in the same state), TestStreamUsesOnlyArrivedAudio (the text emitted for the first half does not depend on the rest of the recording, and a NaN-filled future chunk is rejected without changing the text).
acceptance_items.reproducible_cer_wer: TestEvaluateStreamingReproducible and TestRecognizerIsReproducible; the two CLI reports are identical once the timing object and *_ns fields are removed (reproducibility.txt: True).
acceptance_items.not_sound_classification: The recognizer emits text by greedy CTC decoding over log-mel frames of 1..3 rune utterances and CER/WER are computed on the decoded strings, not on one label per clip. TestRecognizerTrainingLowersCER: on same-distribution held-out utterances CER falls from 0.7778 to 0 (WER 0.8667 to 0, exact 0.1333 to 1.0 over 15 utterances) in 10 epochs.
acceptance_items.speaker_session_split: TestSplitBySpeakerSessionHasNoSpeakerOrSessionLeakage: no speaker or session appears on both sides.

observed_result.cli_fixture: CER 0.6842 -> 0.6316 (13/19 -> 12/19) and WER 0.9 -> 0.9 on 10 held-out utterances from speaker/session groups never seen in training: training works, generalisation to unseen groups is weak.
observed_result.decision: TSK-01 was accepted at fixture level with real data left to TSK-11; the same split applies to TSK-02. The earlier records kept TSK-02 at specified because authorised speech, cross-platform runs and a strict stream file were missing. The stream file has since been verified (stream-file-verification.json); authorised speech is TSK-11 and platform runs are OPS-04, neither is part of TSK-02's acceptance text.

assumption_statement: Synthetic pure tones and a three-rune alphabet prove that training, text decoding, the data pipeline, streaming and resume work on a small fixture; they say nothing about natural speech. Timings are local observations, not microphone-to-text latency or word alignment accuracy.
limitations: Synthetic tones only; no natural or authorised speech (TSK-11, blocked_data).
Generalisation to unseen speaker/session groups is weak: WER stays at 0.9 on the CLI fixture.
Stream files are capped at 64 MiB; larger individuals need the directory bundle path.
Run on one Mac; Linux and Windows were only cross-compiled in the earlier records.
related_evidence: evidence/rl-asr-takeover-20260922/verification.json (2026-09-22 scoped record of the update and streaming APIs; it states itself that it does not establish TSK-02, so it is kept as history rather than listed as passing evidence)
